situations.title: 각성 의식 사정
situations.tagline: Mmm... where... where am I right now?
situations.brief: 마취에서 깨어나는 환자의 각성 상태를 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: You're in the recovery room and your surgery went well.
Can you open your eyes for me?
You're safe — I'm right here with you.

situations.title: 기도 개방 확인
situations.tagline: Let's confirm his airway's patent — I want to hear clear breath sounds before we relax.
situations.brief: 회복 중 환자의 기도 개방 상태를 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's confirm his airway is patent.
I hear clear, unobstructed breath sounds.
Let's reposition his head to keep it open.

situations.title: 산소 투여
situations.tagline: I feel like I can't get a full breath — is that normal?
situations.brief: 회복 중 환자에게 산소를 투여하며 안심시키세요.
keyPhrases: I'm giving you some oxygen to help you breathe easier.
Take slow, deep breaths for me.
Your breathing is doing just fine.

situations.title: 회복 활력 감시
situations.tagline: Let's keep a close eye on her vitals every five minutes while she wakes up.
situations.brief: 회복 중 환자의 활력징후를 지속적으로 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's check her vitals every five minutes.
Her pressure and heart rate look stable.
I'll flag any change right away.

situations.title: 통증·오심 초기 사정
situations.tagline: I'm hurting a lot and I feel really nauseous — I might be sick.
situations.brief: 회복 초기 환자의 통증과 오심을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: On a scale of zero to ten, how bad is your pain?
I can give you something for the nausea right now.
Let me know if it gets worse and I'll help.

situations.title: 지남력 확인
situations.tagline: Wait... is the surgery over? What day is it?
situations.brief: 회복 중 환자의 지남력을 확인하고 안심시키세요.
keyPhrases: Your surgery is all done and it went well.
You're in the recovery room — it's Thursday afternoon.
It's normal to feel foggy as the anesthesia wears off.

situations.title: 호흡 억제 감시
situations.tagline: His respiratory rate's down to eight and shallow — I think the opioids are depressing his breathing.
situations.brief: 회복 중 호흡 억제를 감시하고 조기에 중재하세요.
keyPhrases: His respiratory rate is dropping — now eight.
Let's stimulate him and encourage deep breaths.
I'll have naloxone ready if it worsens.

situations.title: 잔류 근이완 감시
situations.tagline: Her grip's weak and she can't lift her head — I'm worried about residual neuromuscular blockade.
situations.brief: 회복 중 잔류 근이완 여부를 감시하고 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: Her grip strength is weak and head lift is poor.
This may be residual neuromuscular blockade.
Let's notify anesthesia and monitor her closely.

situations.title: shivering 대응
situations.tagline: I'm freezing — I can't stop shaking, it's awful.
situations.brief: 회복 중 shivering을 보이는 환자를 가온하고 중재하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm bringing you warm blankets right now.
The shivering is common as you wake up.
I can give you medication to help it settle.

situations.title: 기도 폐쇄 조기 인지
situations.tagline: I'm hearing snoring respirations — his airway's starting to obstruct, let's reposition now.
situations.brief: 회복 중 기도 폐쇄를 조기에 인지하고 개방하세요.
keyPhrases: I hear snoring — his airway is partially obstructed.
Let's do a jaw thrust and reposition his head.
Get an oral airway ready if needed.

situations.title: 저산소 조기 감시
situations.tagline: Her sat's drifting down to 90 and she looks a little dusky — let's act before it drops further.
situations.brief: 회복 중 저산소증을 조기에 감시하고 중재하세요.
keyPhrases: Her oxygen saturation is drifting down to 90.
Let's increase her oxygen and stimulate her.
Encourage deep breaths and watch the trend.

situations.title: 서맥·저혈압 관찰
situations.tagline: His heart rate's dropped to 48 and pressure's soft — let's watch his hemodynamics closely.
situations.brief: 회복 중 서맥과 저혈압을 관찰하고 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: His heart rate is down to 48 and pressure is low.
Let's recheck and look for a cause.
I'll notify anesthesia if it doesn't improve.

situations.title: Aldrete 점수 평가
situations.tagline: Let's score her Aldrete — I want to make sure she meets criteria before we discharge her.
situations.brief: 회복 중 Aldrete 점수를 평가해 퇴실 기준을 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's calculate her Aldrete score together.
She needs to meet discharge criteria first.
Let's document her activity, breathing, and circulation.

situations.title: 각성 흥분 관찰
situations.tagline: Get these off me — I have to leave, let me go!
situations.brief: 각성 흥분을 보이는 환자를 안전하게 진정시키세요.
keyPhrases: You're safe — your surgery is over.
I'm right here, let me help you settle.
Try to relax and take a slow breath with me.

situations.title: 각성 지연 회복
situations.tagline: She's still not fully waking up — her emergence is slower than expected, let's keep monitoring.
situations.brief: 각성이 지연되는 환자를 감시하고 원인을 살피세요.
keyPhrases: Her emergence is slower than we'd expect.
Let's check for residual anesthetic or other causes.
I'll keep stimulating her and watching closely.

situations.title: 무호흡 발생
situations.tagline: She's stopped breathing — no respiratory effort, I'm bagging her now, call anesthesia!
situations.brief: 회복 중 무호흡이 발생한 환자에게 즉시 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: No respiratory effort — I'm starting bag-mask ventilation.
Call anesthesia and get the airway cart.
Let's check for a reversible cause.

situations.title: 후두경련 재발
situations.tagline: She's laryngospasming again — I can't move air, let's do positive pressure and call for help!
situations.brief: 후두경련이 재발한 환자에게 즉시 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: She's in laryngospasm — apply positive pressure now.
Call anesthesia and prep for medication.
Perform a jaw thrust and get the airway open.

situations.title: 재삽관 필요 판단
situations.tagline: She's not protecting her airway and her sats keep falling — I think we need to reintubate.
situations.brief: 회복 중 재삽관 필요성을 판단하고 팀에 연계하세요.
keyPhrases: She can't protect her airway and is desaturating.
Let's prepare for reintubation.
Call anesthesia and get the intubation kit ready.

situations.title: 마약 과다 호흡정지
situations.tagline: He's in respiratory arrest from the opioids — start bagging, give naloxone, call the code!
situations.brief: 마약 과다로 인한 호흡정지에 즉시 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Respiratory arrest from opioids — bag him now.
Give naloxone and call the code team.
Keep ventilating until he responds.

situations.title: 각성 지연 원인 위기
situations.tagline: He should be awake by now but he's completely unresponsive — something's wrong, let's investigate fast.
situations.brief: 각성이 심각하게 지연된 환자의 원인을 긴급히 파악하세요.
keyPhrases: He's unresponsive well past expected emergence.
Let's check glucose, oxygen, and residual drugs.
Call anesthesia and escalate immediately.

situations.title: 순환 허탈 발생
situations.tagline: His pressure just crashed and he's barely perfusing — we're heading into circulatory collapse, call the code!
situations.brief: 회복 중 순환 허탈이 발생한 환자에게 즉시 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: His pressure has crashed — he's collapsing.
Start fluids, call the code, and get help now.
Let's find the cause while we resuscitate.
